leadText:
(Japanese: オリバ Oriba) is a character of the day who appeared in The Ole' Berate and Switch!.

Oriba and his competed against and in a Pokémon tournament in Sable City. After blocking several attacks, Marowak was eventually defeated by the Pokémon.
